title: A request with no system message produces no system Item
rationale: When the request carries no system message, the provider fills one from the prompt registry (GitHub #216) -- but only when the registry renders something. With nothing to add, neither serializer may synthesize a system Item, empty or otherwise: an empty system message is noise on the wire and a body divergence between the two surfaces. The corpus builds with no prompt registry (a provider-only concern the batch coordinator does not have), so this pins the shared half of the #216 fix: the registry-less no-system-message body is identical on both surfaces and starts with the user turn.
